FINANCE_HEAD.description: Enterprise overseer. Views global analytics and audit logs, approves Dept Head and Finance Manager personal claims, and resolves over-cap escalations. Does not raise personal claims in MVP.

FINANCE_MANAGER.description: Configures dynamic categories and spend tier limits, verifies claims against IST monthly caps, and dispatches reimbursements (peer FM dispatches own claims).

DEPT_HEAD.description: Approves, returns, or rejects claims from employees in their own department. Personal claims route directly to Finance Head.

EMPLOYEE.description: Captures receipts, reviews OCR output, submits claims, and tracks personal monthly INR quota.

categories.name: Meals & Refreshments
categories.description: Business meals, client dining, team lunches, coffee, and working refreshments.

categories.name: Local & Intercity Travel
categories.description: Cab rides (Uber/Ola), metro, rail, flights, airport transfers, and tolls.

categories.name: Hotel & Lodging
categories.description: Business trip hotel stays and accommodation charges (excluding minibar alcohol).

categories.name: Office Supplies
categories.description: Stationery, cables, adapters, printing, and small desk accessories.

categories.name: Software & Subscriptions
categories.description: Approved SaaS tools, cloud developer utilities, and productivity licenses.

categories.name: Internet & Mobile
categories.description: Broadband bills, mobile data packs, and roaming charges for business work.

categories.name: Miscellaneous Business
categories.description: Other documented business expenses not covered by standard categories.
